input.title: Women's Retro – Loose Goose Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This goose zip up hoodie is for the woman who is a little bit of a loose goose, zipped on for the roller rink, the Saturday rolling-around and the slow drive home with the windows down.

A goose in a striped headband rolls along on white roller skates with orange wheels, wings spread wide, in cream, orange and pink with a worn print texture. LOOSE runs above it and GOOSE below in heavy retro serif capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: amber and cream on Black and Navy, burnt orange and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small strutting goose with one foot raised is embroidered on the left chest, and the word HONK is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest strutting goose and left-cuff HONK, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Loose Goose zip hoodie fit?
The Loose Goose goose zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this goose hoodie warm enough for cool rink nights?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool rink nights, breezy boardwalks and the walk back to the car well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, LOOSE above the art and GOOSE below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small strutting goose with one foot raised sits on the left chest with no words, and HONK is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The strutting goose on the chest and the HONK cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a roller skater, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who skates like nobody is watching. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
